meta.title: Moroccan Darija Dataset Source Registry
meta.purpose: Central index of source families reported by the repository. This registry summarizes declarations; it is not independent legal clearance.

sources.rights_holder: ArCode Standard (as declared in repository records)
sources.source_locator_policy: No per-record external locator is applicable to original editorial work; retain contributor and edit history where available.
sources.notes: Counts and permission values reflect the published 1.11.0 repository documentation. Confirm authorship and authority to license before relying on these declarations.

sources.rights_holder: Upstream contributors and applicable rights holders
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (as reported by this repository)
sources.source_locator_policy: Record the exact upstream file, record identifier, or commit whenever it can be established.
sources.notes: Attribution and non-commercial conditions must be preserved. Verify the current upstream license and the mapping of each imported record.

sources.source_name: Wattpad — source texts reported by the project
sources.rights_holder: Authors and other applicable rights holders
sources.license: No blanket license recorded for source stories
sources.source_locator_policy: Do not publish story text. Preserve private audit references only where lawful and permitted; do not infer permission from public accessibility.
sources.notes: The repository reports that 126 lexical items were extracted from stories and that story texts are not redistributed. The permission values above are repository declarations, not verified authorization from authors or platform terms. Exclude these records from downstream training or redistribution until the rights basis is confirmed.

sources.license: Public domain status reported by repository; verify before reuse
sources.source_locator_policy: Record page 163 and the exact glossary item when traceable.
sources.notes: The project reports 37 items from the verb glossary (page 163). Do not generalize a government-work status to third-party material or editorial translations without checking.
